extracted_formulas.name: Thumbs UP/DOWN player projection boost
extracted_formulas.raw_snippet: "Each Thumbs UP/Thumbs DOWN boosts or docks a player by 4% in NBA and 8% in all other sports respectively." (FAQ text in production JS bundle)
extracted_formulas.reconstruction: projection_adjusted = projection * (1 + 0.04) per Thumbs UP in NBA; * (1 + 0.08) in all other sports; Thumbs DOWN docks by the same percentages. Applied as a flat percentage multiplier to the player's base projection.

extracted_formulas.name: Contest simulation methodology (DFS Simulator)
extracted_formulas.raw_snippet: "we then simulate the actual DFS tournament tens of thousands of times (the exact number varies by slate and contest)" ... "the simulations are accounting for ... the correlation between players on the same team and in the same game. Other factors include Vegas totals, weather, teams play calling tendencies, opponents, schemes, and so on." ... "field lineups modeled on what actually gets entered into your specific contest, correlation-aware simulations of every game, and a post-lock dashboard that re-sims your lineups against the actual lineups entered"
extracted_formulas.reconstruction: Contest-level Monte Carlo: (1) model opponent field lineups from actual contest entry distributions; (2) simulate every game with player-level correlation within team and game, adjusting for Vegas totals, weather, play-calling tendencies, opponent, scheme; (3) run tens of thousands of tournament iterations (count varies by slate); (4) post-lock, re-simulate user lineups against the real entered field.
extracted_formulas.citation: https://www.thesolver.com/_next/static/chunks/2913-c097b036b5bbe92c.js (ETR DFS Simulator FAQ) and https://www.thesolver.com/_next/static/chunks/pages/index-267eba5babb577da.js (Simulator product copy)
